label: The "o"
note: The mascot drawn as a chunky white letter "o" with eyes, arms and feet, so the icon is both a letter of our name and our character.

label: Chunky "y"
note: A big glossy purple-to-pink "y" (the name's chunky lettering) with the mascot sitting in its fork, waving.

label: Die-cut sticker
note: The waving mascot as a thick white sticker stuck on at an angle, with one corner peeling up.

label: Pressed to the glass
note: The website's frosted glass with the mascot pressed right up against it: its body blurred, its face sharp.

label: Speech bubble
note: The mascot's head is a chat bubble and its arm swings down to become the bubble's tail, mouth open mid-hello.

label: Clean silhouette
note: A simple white cut-out of the waving mascot on the purple-to-pink gradient: the boldest at small sizes.
